subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil engineer, Marc Masarate
notes: Open-web find on tick 20261015T0818Z (councils and government rotation) after the SEEK pool (3, 7 and 14 day sweeps, 88 detailed) and council boards yielded no publishable advert. email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your graduate program page invites a covering letter and resume at this address, so I am registering my interest in a graduate civil or design engineering role in your Melbourne or Geelong team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am also available for site and regional work.

Designing roads and drainage for new outer suburban communities is the work I want to grow in. My design work so far is from study, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you keep me in mind for your end of year graduate intake or any junior design role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to register my interest in a graduate civil or design engineering role with your Melbourne or Geelong team. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert. Your graduate program page invites a covering letter and resume, and says you usually take on graduates at mid-year and end-of-year.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). The roads, drainage and essential infrastructure your team designs for growing outer metropolitan communities is the work I want to learn.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I helped with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. My design work so far is from study, not a paid role, so I would start at graduate level.

I live in Melton, so both your Melbourne and Geelong offices are within reach. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I've attached my resume and would be glad to talk about your next graduate intake or any junior design role.
